design_philosophy: Authentic medieval Delhi Sultanate courtroom aesthetic. High stakes, cinematic, and game-like. Fusion of Archetype 5 (Luxury/Cinematic/Moody) with Archetype 1 (Earthy/Stone). The UI should feel semi-diegetic, floating above the immersive SVG courtroom scene like a high-end RPG or visual novel. No generic SaaS cards.

primary_heading.usage: Cinematics, Titles, Sultan/Qazi Dialogue Headers, Suspicion Meter Numbers

secondary_ui.usage: Buttons, Chat Log Body, Form Inputs, Stats, Small Labels
secondary_ui.style: Clean geometric sans for readability in dense game UI

rules: DO NOT USE Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Sultan dialogue text must use Cormorant Garamond text-xl to text-2xl for authoritative weight.
Labels over inputs/evidence must be Uppercase + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Never use pure #000000, tint with midnight blue or warm stone.
Use Sultan Gold sparingly for primary CTAs and Evidence borders.
Text on dark overlays must have drop-shadow for APCA contrast compliance.

surfaces.input_field: bg-black/40 border-b border-white/20 focus:border-[#D4AF37] transition-colors rounded-none

textures: Add a subtle grain/noise overlay (`mix-blend-overlay opacity-20`) across the entire screen to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.
Use radial gradients to create vignette effects around the screen edges.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm py-4 px-8 rounded-none

evidence_card.style: parchment_card, hover:-translate-y-2 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/60 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] transition-all cursor-pointer group p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden
evidence_card.image_container: w-full h-24 overflow-hidden grayscale group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-500

dialogue_log.container: crystal_glass, p-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[40vh] flex flex-col gap-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-[#D4AF37]/30
dialogue_log.sultan_bubble: self-start text-left text-[#D4AF37] font-cormorant text-xl leading-relaxed border-l-2 border-[#D4AF37]/50 pl-4

suspicion_meter.container: w-full h-3 bg-black/80 border border-white/10 relative overflow-visible mt-8
suspicion_meter.marker: absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-1 h-8 bg-white shadow-[0_0_10px_white]

spacing_and_grids.philosophy: Cinematic spacing. Wide margins, extreme negative space for title screens, dense precise bento-grids for the trial HUD.
spacing_and_grids.trial_grid_desktop: grid grid-cols-12 gap-6 h-screen w-full p-8
bento_rules: Center Col (col-span-6): SVG Court Scene (Background) + Cinematic overlay
Right Col (col-span-3): Evidence Deck + Witness Interrogation Grid

auth_screen.background: Dark arches night image full screen cover.
auth_screen.layout: Flex center. Form uses 'crystal_glass' surface, minimal inputs. Huge 'Cormorant Garamond' title: 'ENTER THE COURT'.

cover_title_screen.background: Cinematic SVG or Courtroom image with slow zoom effect.
cover_title_screen.layout: Asymmetric. Massive title 'DELHI SULTANATE' left-aligned text-6xl md:text-[8vw] leading-none text-[#D4AF37]. Navigation links (Continue, New Trial, Multiplayer) stacked below with generous line spacing.

choose_sultan_screen.layout: Horizontal scrolling carousel or massive grid. Each Sultan is a card showing their 'Difficulty Tier'. Hovering reveals their traits.
choose_sultan_screen.styling: Cards are dark, borderless until hover. On hover, gold border illuminates.

trial_screen.structure: Semi-diegetic. The SVG Court is the fixed background layer `z-0`. The UI floats in `z-10` using `crystal_glass` surfaces.
trial_screen.top_bar: Suspicion Meter stretches across the top 60% of the screen width, centered. Current % displayed in large serif font.
trial_screen.bottom_bar: Player argument text area spanning col-span-6 in the bottom center. 'Present Evidence' button attached to input.

ending_cinematic.background: Medieval throne shadow image for Condemned, or bright open arch for Freedom.
ending_cinematic.layout: Centered text layout. Typing effect for the final verdict. Massive text scale (text-5xl+).

motion_and_animation.libraries: Framer Motion for UI, GSAP for SVG court scene.

suspicion_meter.bar: Animate width using framer-motion layout. Color interpolates based on value.
suspicion_meter.delta: When suspicion changes, spawn a floating '+15%' text that animates up (y: -20, opacity: 0) over 1.5s.
suspicion_meter.shake: If delta is > 20% (huge penalty), apply a subtle screen shake to the whole UI container.

dialogue.entrance: New messages slide up (y: 10) and fade in (opacity: 1) with a spring transition.

cinematics.screen_transitions: Fade to pure black (bg-[#0A0A0A]) for 1 second between major game states.

auth_bg.description: Dark night passage with arches. Perfect for Auth or Cover screen.

condemned_bg.description: Dark room with medieval chair and light ray. Use for 'Condemned' ending screen.

evidence_coins.description: Stacks of gold coins. Use as thumbnail for the '10,000 Gold Dinars' evidence card.

parchment_texture.description: High-res parchment texture. Use as a background for the Rules screen or letter overlays.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Light weight) for elegant, thin iconography fitting the historical theme.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has text-shadow or adequate backdrop opacity to meet 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for screen shakes and GSAP flashes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: yarn add framer-motion gsap @phosphor-icons/react sonner clsx tailwind-merge
Implement the Suspicion Meter as a reusable component that accepts a `value` and `delta` prop, handling its own animation.
The SVG courtroom background must be separate from the React UI overlays. Put SVG in a fixed div with negative z-index.
Use custom Shadcn components but STRIP OUT standard styles. Apply the 'crystal_glass' and 'buttons.primary' Tailwind strings provided in these guidelines.
Create the Auth flow (JWT + Mock Google) using simple, centered inputs with bottom-borders only (no full boxes) for an elegant look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Do NOT apply `transition: all` globally. Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided media URLs.
Use sonner for toast notifications, configured to look like royal decrees (dark background, gold border).
